Getting Here

🔵 Head to Masbate City center and locate the main public market.

🔵 From the market, head towards Punta Nursery area.

🔵 Look for Purk 7 signage – our church is located in this barangay.

🔵 Ask locals for "Masbate Good News Baptist Church" – we’re well known in the community!

We'd Love to Meet You!

Come visit us this Sunday or contact us anytime. Our church family is excited to welcome you!
